scripts.build: tinacms build --content=local && astro check && astro build && bun run copy:blog-media && pagefind --site dist/client && cp -r dist/client/pagefind public/
scripts.build:local: tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro check && astro build && bun run copy:blog-media && pagefind --site dist/client && cp -r dist/client/pagefind public/"
scripts.preview: tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro build && bun run copy:blog-media" && npx wrangler dev -c dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy: tinacms build --content=local -c "astro build && bun run copy:blog-media" && npx wrangler deploy -c dist/server/wrangler.json
